How to play

Edit a few lines of JavaScript. Pip carries your request to the depot, then brings the response back.

  1. Read the task and change the code.
  2. Press Run delivery.
  3. Check the feedback and try again.

fetch() sends a request. response.json() reads its JSON body. report() is this game’s helper for showing your answer; it is not a built-in JavaScript function.

All API responses are simulated locally. Nothing is sent to a real service. Progress saves in this browser when storage is available.

About the courier artwork

Original transparent robot parts and an authored Spine 4.2-format rig are included in the download. This playtest uses an independent Canvas animation renderer. The rig has not been tested in Spine Editor. Official Spine runtime integration requires a Spine license.
